_instructions: This file draws the 'Little Bear River' schematic page (East Fork down to Cutler Terminus).
See public/schematics/README.md for the full field reference and a longer walkthrough - this is the quick version.
This page ends at the same 'Cutler Reservoir' terminus as lower-logan.json (Little Bear River is one of the inflows
collected there, alongside the main Logan River channel and Blacksmith Fork River). lower-logan.json's own
'little_bear' + 'lb_ext' nodes are the link into this page; this page's own terminus intentionally has no reciprocal
link back out.
NODES: each node is a card on the diagram, listed in the order the water actually flows.
id         - unique within this file. Tributaries/diversions/links reference another node's id via connectsTo.
name       - for kind 'mainstem'/'tributary'/'diversion', must fuzzy-match a live station's display name from
HydroServer/DWRi/USGS, unless stationId is set, in which case that always wins. For 'junction'/'link'
nodes it is just label text.
stationId  - optional but recommended: the exact station id/code to match instead of guessing from name - the same id
used in config/station_config.yaml (usgs_stations/dwri_stations), or a HydroServer station code (a
display_names key, e.g. 'BC_CONF_A'). See README.md for details.
kind       - 'mainstem' (a real gauge station on the main channel), 'junction' (an invisible confluence point on the main
channel, no card - where a tributary/diversion attaches), 'diversion' (water flowing OUT - every
canal/irrigation company on this page is a diversion).
connectsTo - diversion only here: the id of the junction this attaches to.
side       - diversion only, when connectsTo is set: 'left' or 'right', which side of the main channel to draw
the card on - meant to reflect which bank of the river the station is really on, not just picked to avoid
overlap (the layout engine grows vertical spacing to fit a crowded side instead of moving anything to the
other side - see SchematicView.vue's computeLayout()).
colorGroup - optional; must match a name from waterway_groups or schematic_groups in config/station_config.yaml.
terminus   - mainstem only: marks this node as the system's final endpoint (only 'cutler_reservoir' below sets this).
linkTo     - the schematic page slug to navigate to; adds a 'view full system' button below the card it's on. Not
used on this page's terminus node - see the note above about the reciprocal link.
label      - linkTo button text override (defaults to name).
description - terminus node only: subtitle text.
excludeFromOrder - set true on 'cutler_reservoir' below, since the SAME physical reservoir is also the real
'terminus' node on lower-logan.json - without this, whichever page comes first in manifest.json would
silently claim it for the Map/List system filter, same as the bsf_before_conf/little_bear bug this
field was originally added to fix.
There's no separate edges list - the main channel line, every diversion's connector, and flow direction are all derived
automatically from kind + connectsTo + the order nodes appear above.
Every diversion gets its own junction dot, even when two sit right next to each other in real life - see
hyrum_canal_junc and hyrum_irr_junc, which are two separate junctions rather than one shared between both diversions.
South Fork (previously modeled as a tributary joining East Fork at a confluence) and Little Feeder are marked
'future scope: not yet added to schematic' in the canonical site-ordering reference - do not add them back here
until that reference is updated. Likewise Paradise Canal below Black Tube is the only Paradise Canal station in the
current reference - the plain (non-Black-Tube) Paradise Canal station previously chained onto it is not listed there.
